nodes.label: UB1
nodes.title: Locator leak across a capture/spill/output boundary
nodes.description: Holder: N21 flatten-before-spill (re-formed tuple carries logical bytes only; evidenced by the degrade signature vr=1499 ondisk=1) plus the consumer_captures_vr contract (logical.h comment) binding any enabling consumer. D1/D2 are covered by TAP 006; the remaining locator-leak holders for logical output are the N17 residual hard ERROR (with the class-U marker consuming unchanged persistent VR), the E21 refusal, and the stream-sourced capture discipline (E22).

nodes.label: UB2
nodes.title: Stale home OID after relfilenode swap
nodes.description: Holder: REHOME at the single write seam; verified per row by the probe's I-A check post-REPACK (E5). VACUUM FULL/CLUSTER share the seam by construction (E6 active). Hard refusal backstop: heaptoast.c:199 store-gate net rejects (ERROR, ERRCODE_FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED) any VR whose body still references a foreign / non-local TOAST at store time, so a foreign or unlocalized locator can never be persisted.

nodes.label: UB3
nodes.title: Orphan / dangling body
nodes.description: Holder: substrate semantics (chunks die with the owning toast relation / toast vacuum) plus flatten-on-capture (a captured row references no old body after apply). Old-relation drop at swap removes the orphan class for REPACK. Crash recovery needs no VR-specific handling: bodies are TOAST chunks recovered by the normal TOAST/WAL path.

nodes.label: UB4
nodes.title: Physical descriptor in dump/COPY/logical output
nodes.description: Holder set for logical output (M2 state): the N17 class-U marker consumes unchanged persistent VR (LOGICALREP_COLUMN_UNCHANGED, no payload); the residual N17 hard ERROR backstops any leak / transient INMEM that approaches the wire; the E21 refusal blocks datum-printing consumers from live-reading VR bodies under historic snapshots; the E22 stream-sourced capture discipline converts class-S VR to ordinary logical bytes before the writer. For dump/COPY: the N8 flatten inside detoast_attr - evidenced by TAP 006 round trips on both COPY formats and both dump formats (the v1.0 gap at this boundary is closed).

nodes.label: UB5
nodes.title: Unbounded materialization on capture paths
nodes.description: Holder: vr_logical_capture_limit checked before any body access, per value, in the one shared seam; worker-side refusal and retry evidenced (E9/E10 threshold runs). Lifting the bound = streaming reconstruction, out of scope by accepted decision.

nodes.label: UB7
nodes.title: decoded-WAL implies gated construction (I-B)
nodes.description: Holder: C1. Any WAL range a logical slot can decode must not contain freshly-constructed VR the consumer cannot interpret; construction is refused inside an active logical-decoding window. This is where WAL safety lives in the VR line (there is no separate WAL pipeline). Crash recovery itself is subsumed by substrate semantics (UB3): VR bodies are ordinary TOAST chunks and inherit TOAST/WAL crash-safety; the VR descriptor adds no recovery-specific path.

edges.label: E6
edges.title: rewrite REHOME via VACUUM FULL / CLUSTER
edges.description: rewrite localizes a VR body into the rewritten relation. Single write seam (toast_helper.c:243 vr_rewrite_action -> REHOME; heaptoast.c:199 store-gate net). All four rewrite commands (VACUUM FULL, CLUSTER, ALTER rewrite, non-concurrent REPACK) funnel through cluster_rel/raw_heap_insert -> heap_toast_insert_or_update (ALTER via table_tuple_insert). Dedicated test inventory closed by t/015: each leg proves a real rewrite (relfilenode changed), vr_storage_ok=1, no orphan body, logical value preserved.
evidence: Frida runtime (tree 6583c64d, -O0 postgres) cross-check of VR_GRAPH_COMPILED_AUDIT_V0: vr_rewrite_action=24 via two call-sites (toast_tuple_init x12 + heap_toast_insert_or_update x12); vr_toast_body_copy_to_relation=12 — matches gdb.

edges.label: E7
edges.title: foreign VR localize-on-write
edges.description: A persistent VR descriptor that references another relation's body storage is not persisted as-is. On write the body is copied into the target relation's storage; the descriptor is rewritten to the local storage OID; the value remains VR (it is not flattened to ORD). Code path is VR_RW_REHOME (vr_toast.c:157; toast_helper.c:243). heaptoast.c:199 is the store-gate net that refuses any remaining foreign locator. Verified by t/015 (foreign-origin forge -> localize-on-write -> survives VACUUM FULL, vr_storage_ok=1).
